headline: 51 Companies Bid for Pariachi Tunnel Construction on Peru's Central Highway
summary: Peru's infrastructure authorities received interest from 51 companies for the Pariachi tunnel project. The 180-kilometer Nueva Carretera Central highway infrastructure project requires a total investment of 25.5 billion soles.
why: The Nueva Carretera Central is a critical infrastructure corridor linking Peru's capital, Lima, to eastern agricultural and mining regions.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Major public infrastructure bidding stimulates domestic construction sector investment.
